doc.name: Booqer
doc.description: Finds verified Booqer shops and hands a booking to the shop page. A keyless consult is confirmed when the slot is open. Canonical shop pages are on https://booqer.ai.

skills.name: List verified shops
skills.description: List verified Booqer shops and the URL of each shop page.
examples: Which verified shops can I book?

skills.name: Open a shop booking page
skills.description: Return the semantic booking page for one verified shop.
examples: Book a visit with a shop
